remaining_limitations: Runtime acceptance still requires all ten nodes in the fresh490 run, validated actual private outputs, exact query and owner recorder evidence, PBSeq decode, expected process exit/cleanup semantics, and the original test/JUnit semantic assertions.

Foreign HBA restoration is performed from the original bytes retained in memory and pg_ctl reload return code; the test does not persist a post-restore HBA readback. This mapping does not claim an independently recorded effective-rule verification after restoration.

The foreign deployment proposal hash is present as a nested object in foreign-deployment-sql-observations.json and summary value; there is no standalone proposal artifact, so the raw-artifact checker cannot add a cross-file SHA link for it. The source test independently recomputes and asserts the domain digest.
